question.text: The gas which has similar shape and bond order as that of azide ion is:

solution.text: Azide ion <math><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msubsup></math> has linear shape and bond order = <math> <mrow>  <mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo></mrow></math> same as <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>.
